topics.topic: NITI Aayog Releases Report on “Revitalizing Apprenticeship Ecosystem”
topics.why_in_news: NITI Aayog released report titled “Revitalizing Apprenticeship Ecosystem” focusing on skill development, employability enhancement and industry-linked workforce training reforms.
prelims_quick_notes: Apprenticeship combines practical training with workplace learning.
Report focuses on strengthening India’s skilling ecosystem.
Apprenticeship important for employability and industry readiness.
India has large demographic dividend requiring skilled workforce.
Industry participation critical for apprenticeship success.
Skill development linked with economic growth and productivity.
Apprentices Act governs apprenticeship framework in India.
Formal skilling reduces unemployment and skill mismatch.
important_facts: NITI Aayog is policy think tank of Government of India.
National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme supports apprenticeship expansion.
Apprenticeship differs from ordinary classroom education.
key_highlights: Focus on improving apprenticeship participation rates.
Need for digital and future-ready skills highlighted.
Recommendations aimed at improving employability outcomes.
Policy reforms suggested for easier apprenticeship integration.
exam_relevance: Important for Social Justice, Skill Development and Employment.
Useful for demographic dividend and human capital topics.
Can be linked with labour reforms and inclusive growth.
prelims_traps: NITI Aayog functions as policy think tank.
Apprenticeship focuses on practical workplace training.
Skill development directly linked with employability and productivity.
